end.summary:
Practised multiplying numbers ending in zeros by multiplying non-zero parts and counting zeros.
Rudra made 6 attempts and answered 2 unaided correctly.
They counted zeros in the factors, including a zero already present in the non-zero product.
The mix-up in 500 × 60 = 3,000 was not corrected by the last seen attempt; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised separating the non-zero parts, multiplying them, and then adding the zeros from both factors. Rudra explained their zero-counting method several times, but sometimes added an extra zero when the product already ended in 0; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, practise a few examples such as 50 × 60 and 500 × 60, writing the non-zero multiplication first and checking the final zero count together.

skills.skill: Multiply numbers ending in zeros by multiplying the non-zero parts and counting zeros

misconceptions.belief: Drops a zero when the non-zero parts already make a number ending in 0 (500 × 60 = 3,000)
